items.title: 4 Companies Just Raised Their Dividends. Which Payout Has the Most Room to Grow?
items.summary: Visa, Entergy, Tennant, and Fortis all just lifted their quarterly payouts, but a dividend raise is only as good as the cash flow standing behind it. One of these four companies raised its payout while its earnings coverage was already running thin.

items.title: Visa vs Mastercard: growth, valuation, and fair value compared
items.summary: Investing.com -- As of November 3, 2026 at 1:41 PM EST, Visa Inc (V) trades at $422.50, while Mastercard Inc (MA) trades at $650.40. Both have nearly identical trailing P/E ratios, but Mastercard carries the stronger growth profile.

items.title: Ackman calls stock market "broken" but touts Visa, MasterCard and Netflix
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bill Ackman expressed concern on Tuesday about the current state of the stock market, stating that increased speculative trading has created excessive price volatility driven by high levels of leverage.

items.title: Fiserv Just Gained 17% in a Month: Take Profits, or Buy More?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysFiserv shares are up 17% in the past month, off their 52-week low, as payments stocks like Mastercard and Visa rallied while the Nasdaq fell. Analysts cut their price targets through October, and Fiserv’s own news didn’t explain the rally.

items.title: Visa (V) Signs Two New Deals To Push AI Commerce And Digital Payments
items.summary: Visa (NYSE:V) has signed new Memorandums of Understanding to support AI-enabled commerce and digital payments in Hong Kong and Senegal. The agreement with Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks focuses on applying artificial intelligence to fintech and digital commerce solutions. The separate accord with the Government of Senegal targets wider digital payment adoption as part of the country's financial inclusion agenda.
